# The Pharisee and the Tax Collector (Luke 18:13)

## Emotional Focus
Being humble when we talk to God.

## Key KJV
“God be merciful to me a sinner.” (Luke 18:13)

## Gentle Retelling
A proud man prayed big proud words. A tax collector prayed, “God be merciful to me a sinner.” Jesus said the humble one went home right with God.

## Coloring Prompt
The tax collector kneeling humbly while the proud man stands tall.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“God loves a humble heart.”
